question: How many Sundays per year must an employee have off?

final.answer: At least 15 Sundays per year must remain free of work for employees (ArbZG § 11 Abs. 1). Section 12 Abs. 2 allows lower minimums only for certain listed sectors, such as facilities under § 10 Abs. 1 Nr. 2, 3, 4 and 10, which require at least 10.

Question:
How many Sundays per year must an employee have off?

blocks.text:
The rulebook answers this directly. Under ArbZG § 11 Abs. 1, at least 15 Sundays per year must remain free of work.

Note that § 12 Abs. 2 allows lower minimums for certain sectors (for example, at least 10 Sundays in the facilities listed there), but the general rule for this department is 15.
